description: Token info for an Arc token before showing it: name, symbol, decimals, supply, Circle's USDC/EURC or not, who launched it and when (from our launch index, never guessed), USDC pool count, deepest pool price and liquidity, risk signals. A wallet or non-token is refused before payment. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_token_info
